mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals robust consumer demand for new construction, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to accelerated economic activity and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST level as a 5-day return predictor falls below 0.03, or 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals labor market tightness and manufacturing resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint condition UNRATE < 4% AND INDPRO > 105 occurs in more than 60% of cases where 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a CPIAUCSL level above 250 signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand persons signals strong labor market conditions and consumer spending capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through accelerated retail and services sector growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS level as a 5-day return predictor falls below 0.03, or 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% per annum signals labor market tightness, increasing wage growth and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signals synchronized manufacturing and construction sector expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated capital expenditure and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The joint condition INDPRO > 105 AND HOUST > 1200 occurs in more than 60% of cases where 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 during a late-cycle expansion.
